description: This file provides utility methods for working with ByteBuffer objects, including cloning ByteBuffers, creating empty ByteBuffers, and converting ByteBuffers to UTF-8 strings.

classes.name: ByteBufferUtils
classes.description: A utility class offering static methods for ByteBuffer operations such as cloning, creating empty buffers, and converting buffers to UTF-8 strings.

methods.name: clone
methods.description: Deeply clones a given ByteBuffer, preserving the remaining content.

methods.name: empty
methods.description: Creates and returns an empty ByteBuffer.

methods.name: toUtf8String
methods.description: Converts a ByteBuffer to a UTF-8 encoded String, returning null if the input is null.
